lines.2: 「You really like the roof, don't you?」
lines.4: 「Don't look at me like, 'Oh, it's just you, Senpai.'」
lines.5: 「That is exactly what I was thinking.」
lines.6: ...Getting mad here would end the conversation.
lines.7: As her senior, I needed to maintain at least some communication with her.
lines.8: 「So, how's the student council executive committee?」
lines.12: 「Honestly, I would like to quit as soon as possible.」
lines.13: 「When will a permanent member be joining?」
lines.14: 「No idea. The Princess handles all the personnel decisions.」
lines.16: Yashi shot me a hard look.
lines.17: 「I said I would fill in, so I will stay for a while.」
lines.18: 「But if this drags on too long, I am leaving.」
lines.20: 「Want to head to the student council room, then?」
lines.22: 「...What? It's almost time for everyone to meet.」
lines.23: 「No, thank you. I don't want to look at your face.」
lines.25: 「This is exactly why I dislike you, Senpai. You always snap at me like that. It's creepy.」
lines.27: She looked at me as though I were beneath her.
lines.28: She technically spoke politely, but that only made the wall between us feel higher.
lines.29: She had a lot of presence for a first-year.
